description: Forbidden Siren (Sony 2003, PAL PS2, via PCSX2)
long: Forbidden Siren is a survival horror game set in the cursed Japanese village of Hanuda, where the dead rise as relentless "Shibito" after a failed ritual. Its signature "sightjacking" mechanic lets players tap into enemies' vision to plan stealthy movement, as the helpless cast must mostly evade rather than fight. This PlayStation 2 release runs via the PCSX2 emulator.
